integrity: All universal conclusions rest on a complete analytic proof; finite checks are independent computational diagnostics, not an infinite proof or independent audit. The three-mode spectral decomposition and total-variation duality are standard mathematical ingredients.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge complete bipartite graphs only, degree exponent 0 <= theta <= 1, unweighted vertex-supremum input and unit-edge Lipschitz output. For 0 < theta < 1 at least one temporal crossing is shown but global uniqueness is not claimed. Possible earlier equivalent total-variation or Markov-coupling formulations remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Degree normalization reverses sharp heat-gradient ordering on complete bipartite graphs
